content:
maya: Quick idea — run a compact webinar + benchmark narrative to drive a micro-activation lift. Offer a tiny starter credit pack (150 tokens) + curated prompt templates during webinar. Aim: improve FR (first-request) -> activation within 24h by 12% :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jordan: Love it. What metrics are we tracking? activation rate, 1st-5-requests conversion, retention at 7d?

maya: Exactly. Primary: activated within 24h. Secondary: avg tokens in first session, % using prompt templates, webinar -> repo click rate.

samir: Quick operational Q — routing inbound leads from webinar signups: do we send to SDRs or straight into an automated onboarding drip? We should A/B that.

olivia: A/B makes sense. Variant A: immediate SDR handoff for high-intent (company email + >5 team members). Variant B: automated onboarding with credit drip + in-console prompt pack.

bex (growth-eng): I can set up the segmentation for A/B. Proposed rule: if company_domain in allowlist OR company_size>50 => SDR route; else automated. I can share the routing JSON.

bex (growth-eng): ```
{
  "cohort": "webinar_signup",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "company_size>50", "route":"sdr"},
    {"else": "auto_onboard"}
  ]
}
```

maya: Perfect. For the automated flow: send welcome email with 150 token credit, 3 prompt templates (onboarding, search, rewriter), and an in-app nudge at first API call to try the templates.

jordan: Can we bake a tiny benchmark narrative into the webinar slides + a one-pager? e.g., "latency and cost per 1k tokens for starter templates" — useful for PMs and early adopters.

olivia: Yes. I'll draft the one-pager. Also propose a short survey 48h after webinar to capture judged value and any quality regressions.

samir: Measurement plan: tag all webinar signups with utm=webinar_pulse and cohort=webinar_apr. Track funnel: signup -> first api request -> activated -> used_prompt_pack -> paid_conversion (30d).

maya: Timeline: signoff on slides by Tue EOD, landing page + routing in place Wed, webinar Thurs. Bex — can you spin up the landing with the credit gating copy?

bex (growth-eng): On it. Copy draft in #marketing-drafts by lunch. Also adding analytics events: webinar_signup, credit_granted, prompt_pack_used.

jordan: Quick copy note — use microcopy: "Get started: 150 free tokens + 3 ready-to-run prompts". Keep it short and PLG-first.

olivia: Will iterate. Also recommend a tiny benchmark snippet in the slide: "Starter template — median latency 220ms, cost ~$0.02 per 1k tokens" (placeholder, will replace with real numbers).

maya: Great. Can we reconvene tomorrow morning for a quick pre-launch review (15m)?

everyone: +1

launch-bot: Reminder — webinar event created in calendar for Thu 11:00. :calendar:

maya: Thanks — I'll post the final landing link here once live. Let's track conversion hourly during the webinar and immediate 24h activation rate.
